dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Oh, you're from the city!

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Rafting down the river here is the most fun!

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: You can hear the water the whole time—it feels like you're swimming.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Yeah, the sound of water is really something.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Right? Though when I grow up, part of me wants to leave this village...

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Did you see the work in the field?

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Yeah. Pulling weeds looked like hard work.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: They do that all the time. Summer and winter.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: I want to help too, but I'm still too small.

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: Grandma always does it by herself.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Wouldn't it be better if everyone helped?

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: But Grandma says she has her own way of doing things.

updateNotebook.memo: Weeding is a daily task that continues through summer and winter.
updateNotebook.quote: They do that all the time. Summer and winter.
updateNotebook.speaker: child2

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Did you find something else?

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Did you see that empty house?

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Yeah. Looks like nobody lives there.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: That place is our secret base.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: There's a big chest inside, and hiding in it is really fun.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: I see. But isn't it a little scary?

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Not at all. But... I wonder if my big brother will ever come back.

updateNotebook.memo: The empty house is the kids' secret base. But someone hasn't come back.
updateNotebook.quote: I wonder if my big brother will ever come back.
updateNotebook.speaker: child1

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: The water's cold and feels so good!

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Do you play in the river a lot?

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: Grandpa said they used to play here even more in the old days.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: They used to get on a boat here and ride it all the way to Lake Biwa.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: From this river to Lake Biwa?

dialogs.speaker: child2
dialogs.text: Yeah. The water goes all the way over there, he said.

dialogs.speaker: child1
dialogs.text: We don't play like that much anymore, though.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: The water flowing through the village connects all the way to Lake Biwa...

updateNotebook.memo: The Okawa River flows from the village to Lake Biwa.
updateNotebook.quote: They used to get on a boat here and ride it all the way to Lake Biwa.
updateNotebook.speaker: child1
